context:
Sweep one method group at a time (join operations, group_by, expression
classes) so review can focus on a coherent slice. Use ast tooling for
the survey to avoid grep false positives - Any can appear in
type aliases, return positions, parameter positions, and dict/list
generic args.
description:
Follow-up to quality-define-dataframe-protocol-and-remove-any.

The protocol foundation lives at benchbox/platforms/dataframe/protocol.py
(LazyFrameLike). Polars LazyFrame/DataFrame, Pandas DataFrame, and
PyArrow Table satisfy isinstance() against it; conformance tests pin
the contract.

The annotation migration in unified_frame.py (4,138 lines, 82 Any
references) was deliberately deferred to its own slice because:
  - High blast radius: every benchmark execution path touches this file
  - Library-specific dispatch in many methods means not every Any can
    become LazyFrameLike - some need concrete library types
  - Should land alongside ty diagnostic reduction (93 in dataframe layer
    today) so the gain is visible

This TODO does the migration in reviewable slices.

anti_patterns.dont: add runtime isinstance() checks at every call
bundle the survey + migration into one commit
anti_patterns.instead: survey first, then migrate per category
anti_patterns.why: it loses the ability to revert just the migration
not every Any is a generic-dispatch site

preserves.behavior: All dataframe-platform tests pass on Polars, Pandas, PyArrow at minimum
Lazy-loading of optional backends preserved (TYPE_CHECKING imports for library-specific types)
Runtime behavior of unified_frame.py unchanged - annotations only
ty diagnostic count does not increase from baseline 93

work_units.summary: Survey unified_frame.py: classify each `Any` annotation as (a) generic dispatch -> LazyFrameLike, (b) library-specific -> concrete type, (c) genuine escape hatch -> keep with comment. Output CSV.

work_units.notes: Verified (a) count after hand-walking: only 2 genuine generic-dispatch sites (wrap_dataframe + UnifiedLazyFrame.join). Both migrated in commit 486c21640. The other 23 heuristic-flagged (a) sites were re-classified as (b) library-specific or (c) escape-hatch - see Heuristic limitations + Re-classification log in docs/development/unified_frame_any_survey.md.
work_units.summary: Migrate category (a) - generic-dispatch sites - to LazyFrameLike. One commit per ~20 sites for review bounding.

work_units.notes: 21 (b) sites migrated to concrete types under TYPE_CHECKING imports across commits 3b8fa0e57 (1 polars helper), 6a191d677 (8 pyspark join methods), 4b11df2f8 (10 datafusion expr/df sites), 4baac9f50 (3 datafusion ast/agg helpers). 11 sites originally heuristic- flagged (b) were re-classified to (c) (runtime probes + Unified*Expr.__init__ family) and documented per re-classification log.
work_units.summary: Migrate category (b) - library-specific sites - to concrete types (e.g., polars.LazyFrame, pyspark.sql.DataFrame). Use TYPE_CHECKING imports to preserve lazy-load semantics.

work_units.notes: Used class-level rationale blocks instead of one-comment-per-method to avoid noise. Coverage: UnifiedExpr class docstring (covers ~17 method-param sites), arithmetic dunder section comment (16 sites), UnifiedWhen/UnifiedWhenThen class docstrings (5 sites), UnifiedExpr.native + .collect + .scalar docstrings (3 return sites), _is_* predicate section comment (4 sites). Commits: 7226876a3, 3b8fa0e57, 3398d9457, f137b20dc.
work_units.summary: For category (c) escape-hatch Any, add inline comment explaining why a more specific type would be wrong. The goal is meaningful Any, not zero Any.

work_units.notes: ty diagnostic count steady at 93 (= baseline) after every w2/w3/w4 commit. No new errors surfaced - the prior Any annotations were not masking type errors in the migrated sites. Verified after final commit f137b20dc.
work_units.summary: Run `uv run ty check benchbox/platforms/dataframe/` against /tmp/ty_baseline.txt (93 diagnostics). Confirm no new errors; fix any that appear (those are real bugs the prior Any was hiding).
